steps.label: a new game: Gus's secret is built (cache, key, chest) and no flags are set
steps.expect: (() => { const m = r.match(/^set up; secret parts: (.*); flags (.*)$/); if (!m) return false; const parts = m[1].split(', '); return ['cache', 'key', 'keySpot', 'chest'].every((p) => parts.includes(p)) && m[2] === '{}'; })()

steps.label: autopilot ready
standing at the edge with the glider
steps.expect: /^at the edge with the glider: actions /.test(r)

steps.label: GLIDE pressed
in the air: gliding high, at a glider's speed and sink, the HUD showing them, the cast button hidden and the hands on the brakes
steps.expect: (() => { const m = r.match(/^in the air ([\d.]+) s \(game loop\): height (-?\d+) m, (\d+) km\/h, sink (-?[\d.]+) m\/s; HUD "(\d+)m up ▼ ([\d.]+) m\/s (\d+)km\/h"; cast button hidden (true|false), hands on the brakes (true|false)$/); return !!m && +m[1] >= 3.2 && +m[2] > 10 && +m[3] >= 20 && +m[3] <= 60 && +m[4] > 0.3 && +m[4] < 4 && Math.abs(+m[5] - +m[2]) <= 2 && Math.abs(+m[6] - +m[4]) <= 0.2 && Math.abs(+m[7] - +m[3]) <= 3 && m[8] === 'true' && m[9] === 'true'; })()

steps.label: looking up at the wing
the flight ends on foot next to the grotto, the wing packed away
steps.expect: (() => { const m = r.match(/^landed after ([\d.]+) s at \((-?[\d.]+), (-?[\d.]+)\) y (-?[\d.]+), ([\d.]+) m from the key; mode (\w+), canopy (true|false); track/); return !!m && +m[1] < 130 && Number.isFinite(+m[4]) && +m[5] < 15 && m[6] === 'foot' && m[7] === 'false'; })()

steps.label: facing the grotto
in the grotto with the key at hand height
steps.expect: (() => { const m = r.match(/^in the grotto: feet (-?[\d.]+), key (-?[\d.]+), actions /); return !!m && +m[2] - +m[1] > 0 && +m[2] - +m[1] < 2; })()

steps.eval: (async () => { const g = __rhf.game; const t0 = g.time; await __until(() => g.time > t0 + 0.25, 90000); return 'actions ' + __ia(); })()
steps.label: in the grotto the pill offers TAKE KEY

steps.eval: (async () => { const g = __rhf.game; await __until(() => g.state.flags.key, 60000); return 'took the key: ' + !!g.state.flags.key + ', key shown ' + g.props.secret.key.visible + ', banner "' + document.getElementById('banner').textContent + '", toasts: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('#toasts .toast')].map((t) => t.textContent).join(' | '); })()
steps.label: the key is taken: flag set, key hidden, the SECRET KEY banner up
steps.expect: /^took the key: true, key shown false, banner "[^"]*SECRET KEY/.test(r)

steps.label: on the ledge facing north a launch is possible
steps.expect: /^on the ledge facing north: actions .*, can launch true$/.test(r)
